first_post.cooked:
Greetings, friends!

Patch 37.0 is here! As a reminder, this will be our Highlights and Known Issues thread for the whole Reign of the Black Empire cycle.

Please find below some of the issues we’re tracking, with updates to follow as we learn more.

Thanks for your help raising any potential issues as you come across them!

Highlights & Info
  • During the early moments of the Reign of the Black Empire launch, some in-game Shop purchases incorrectly displayed Tavern Tender during checkout. This issue has already been resolved, and affected players will receive an email tomorrow with more information.
  • We’re investigating a bug with achievement XP
  • [Bans] These will be added to the drop-down menu below (the list is also mirrored here). If your Arena deck contains a banned card, you will need to retire it manually (your ticket should be refunded).
Hearthstone Standard/Wild Bans
  • [Standard] Bat Mask, Divergence, Reach Equilibrium
  • [Wild] Godfrey the Betrayer, Reincarnate

Battlegrounds Bans
  • Trinkets: Both Kiri’s Double Eclipse Trinkets, Minion Bait, Putricide Sticker.
  • Minions: Gentle Djinni.
Arena Bans
  • This jail is empty.

Note: If your deck contains a banned card (you will see it with a reddish hue), you will need to retire. You will receive the rewards obtained until that point, and the cost of the run will be refunded to you. The Tickets will be added directly to your account.


Tavern Brawl Bans
  • This Jail is empty.

Note: If your deck contains a banned card (you will see it with a reddish hue), you will need to retire. You will receive the rewards obtained until that point, and the cost of the run (2 Tickets) will be refunded to you if applicable. The Tickets will be added directly to your account.

Tracked Issues

- Now split by type -

HEARTHSTONE / WILD

  • Detained for Destruction (one of the cards related to Godfather Kazakus) is blank in localized clients.
  • Ladder Ready Paladin deck uses “Pure Paladin” card mechanics but contains a Neutral card (Taelan Fordring).
  • Crosshair VFX can clip through the board (Example: this can happen when you play Mayor Noggenfogger).
  • When minion is assembled with Rustrot Viper as top component trade costs zero mana.
  • Locations and dormant minions disrupt placement of Ravitz’s Rush and Immune buffs.
  • Tricksy Improviser displays incorrect stats (4/4 instead of 4/3).
  • Tess Greymane can’t replay herself after playing a hero card from another class.
  • Silenced Titan minions cannot attack when playing on mobile (and must be clicked to select, then clicked to target, rather than dragged when playing on desktop).
  • Mismatched ownership of minions on board after triggering Typhoon.

BATTLEGROUNDS

  • [Mobile] It is not always possible to target cards on the right side of your hand with discard activate effects. We’re investigating.
  • Kiri’s Double Eclipse prevents newly discovered hero powers from working. Both Trinkets will be banned for now.

BRAWL / ARENA

  • N/A

COLLECTION / WEB / UI / SHOP / FEATS (ACHIEVEMENTS) / DECKS

  • We’re investigating a bug with achievement XP
  • [Mobile] Inspecting an opponent’s Old God in play on mobile with a large hand size can prevent the player from taking actions.
  • [Collection] Some unowned skins are indicated as obtainable through the Reign of the Black Empire Tavern Pass. All Tavern Pass items are listed here.
  • [Feat/Achievement] Black Empire Neutral Collector Feat cannot be completed. We’re having a look.
  • [UI - Hearthstone] Mana gem drop shadows appear shifted to the left.
  • [Shop/UI] Clicking on Black Empire packs can open Violet Hold packs. We’re investigating.
  • [Feat] Some Feats cannot be claimed when completed in the new Journal (example: Tavern Regular).
  • [Feat] Golden C’Thun, Eye of the Empire is not counted for the Old Gods Collector Feat. We’re investigating.
  • [Shop] Missing Sequence bundle in the in-game Shop: please restart your client.
  • [Black Market] Modes other than Ranked Hearthstone incorrectly display Bloodstone gains (none is actually received, as intended).
  • [UI] Diamond ‘Ultraxion’ animation is replaced with Golden if certain Dark Gift is applied
  • [Shop] Some bundles are offered to players that already have them.
  • [Collection] Multiple cards have lost their golden animation.
Resolved Issues
  • [Random Legendary Cards Missing] We’re aware that random Legendary cards from pre-purchase bundles are not being delivered right now. We’re on it, thank you for your reports.
    • This issue has been resolved.
  • [Shop] Perils in Paradise packs are currently unavailable in the in-game shop.
    • Packs are back in the shop, at the intended price.

For a list of bugs resolved with recent patches, please check the latest updates in the “Useful Links” category.

Useful Links

36.6.3 Patch Notes
36.6.2 Hotfix Patch
